QuestInfo.name: [Karote] The First Statue
QuestInfo.0:
What #bIrena#k found was a #bstatue#k.
Among the remains of the tower, it's still in pristine condition...
Investigate the #bstatue#k and see what you can learn.
QuestInfo.1:
When you touched the statue,
a magical force dragged sucked you in!
You're somewhere else now, surrounded by enemies.
Defeat the enemies first, then find a way out!
QuestInfo.2:
After the battle with the monsters,
you encountered the #bstatue#k again.
You witnessed an event from #bsomeone else's memory#k.
Whoever the memory belonged to, his face resembled the #bstatues#k from before.
The memory ended with him falling into the sea, rejected from an experiment.
